display.title: Episode 166: The Mystery of Toras Emes, Chapter 1 (Purim)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's Purim show: the Purim Merrymakers land in Studio 604, a new story begins about a wicked officer's plot against a kind king's Jews, and a guest sings Purim songs.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi's Purim program, broadcast on the eve of Taanis Esther. Every time Uncle Yossi tries to open the show he is interrupted by strange noises and laughter, until a helicopter lands in Studio 604 and out march the Purim Merrymakers, little soldiers of Tzivos Hashem who remind everyone that on Purim it is a mitzvah to be happy. Story time, in honor of Purim, begins 'The Mystery of Toras Emes': a kind king lets the Jews learn Torah freely, and they honor him on each visit with a procession led by the rabbi carrying a Sefer Torah. A jealous officer, like Haman, tricks Chaim the shammes into preparing an empty, make-believe Torah scroll for the procession, planning to expose it to the king. Between the two halves of the story, a third-grade girl leads the Shema. Uncle Yossi promises that, as with Haman, the plot will turn against its maker in the next chapter. A guest singer then leads Purim songs while listeners sound their gragers. The show closes with the Torah trivia club offer and reminders for Taanis Esther, the Megillah, matanos la'evyonim and mishloach manos.
display.lesson: Hashem turns the plots of the Jews' enemies against them, just as He did with Haman; and on Purim it is a mitzvah to be happy.

date.note: Said on air: 'tomorrow, that is Wednesday, is Taanis Esther' and the Megillah is read tomorrow night (13 Adar 5745 = Wed 6 Mar 1985).

advisories.note: A jealous royal officer, compared to Haman, schemes to have the Jews forbidden to learn Torah.

privacy.note: The Shema guest is named in full with her school, class and teacher; a guest singer is named.

sources_cited.note: Haman hanged on the gallows he built for Mordechai.
